title: Great Is the Lord

questions.question: Contend, O Lord, with those who contend with me; fight against those who what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:1 (ESV): "Contend, O Lord, with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me!"

questions.question: Take hold of shield and buckler and rise for my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:2 (ESV): "Take hold of shield and buckler and rise for my help!"

questions.question: Draw the spear and javelin against my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:3 (ESV): "Draw the spear and javelin against my pursuers!"

questions.question: Say to my soul, "I am your what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:3 (ESV): "...say to my soul, 'I am your salvation.'"

questions.question: Let them be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the Lord driving them where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:5 (ESV): "Let them be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the Lord driving them away!"

questions.question: Let their way be dark and slippery, with the angel of the Lord pursuing whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:6 (ESV): "Let their way be dark and slippery, with the angel of the Lord pursuing them!"

questions.question: For without cause they hid their net for me; without cause they dug a pit for my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:7 (ESV): "For without cause they hid their net for me; without cause they dug a pit for my life."

questions.question: Then my soul will rejoice in the Lord, exulting in his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:9 (ESV): "Then my soul will rejoice in the Lord, exulting in his salvation."

questions.question: All my bones shall say, "O Lord, who is like you, delivering the poor from him who is too strong for him, the poor and needy from him who does what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:10 (ESV): "...the poor and needy from him who robs him?"

questions.question: Malicious witnesses rise up; they ask me of things that I do not what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:11 (ESV): "Malicious witnesses rise up; they ask me of things that I do not know."

questions.question: They repay me evil for good; my soul is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:12 (ESV): "They repay me evil for good; my soul is bereft."

questions.question: But when they were sick—I wore sackcloth; I afflicted myself with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:13 (ESV): "But when they were sick—I wore sackcloth; I afflicted myself with fasting;"

questions.question: Let not those rejoice over me who are wrongfully my enemies, nor let them wink the eye who hate me without what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:19 (ESV): "...nor let them wink the eye who hate me without cause."

questions.question: Let those be put to shame and disappointed altogether who rejoice at my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:26 (ESV): "Let those be put to shame and disappointed altogether who rejoice at my calamity;"

questions.question: Great is the Lord, who delights in the welfare of his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 35:27 (ESV): "...Great is the Lord, who delights in the welfare of his servant!"

key_verse_text: Then my soul will rejoice in the Lord, exulting in his salvation.
